scope: Bounded mono Saturn development comparison; conventional unsharpened reference is not ground truth.

decision: Both optional improvements pass both pilot metrics. Proceed to full-capture preprocessing and one paired all-screened validation before broader claims. Keep global, linear and all-screened defaults; no sharpening or exponent sweep.
limitations: Sample-based screening is not full-capture screening. Global uses the best selected frame; both local arms use the same independent 64-frame template and identical raw projections. The mono array is replicated into identical channels only for the existing comparison calculation. No distributed capture pixels.
reference_pixel_check: Stored 16-bit replicated-mono RGB pixels span 0 to 45874; maximum occupies one spatial pixel. The clipped preview does not represent stored data.

residual_followup.scope: Exploratory diagnosis of the completed pilot; does not replace the pending full-capture gate.
residual_followup.frequency_split: Gaussian sigma 3 residual component and its complement; components are not orthogonal.

sample_photometry.method: Full-frame sum after subtracting median of the outer 12-pixel border. Same fixed 1024 sampled frames and screening decisions.

residual_followup.interpretation: Stronger weights reduce both broad and fine residuals. Small integrated-brightness variation and weak correlation with quality do not motivate adding brightness normalization from this sample. Await full-capture results before selecting another algorithm change.
